jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
That thing we do

We're the Operating System for the Music Industry - a platform that pumps up the jam of every play.

We connect all players of the industry to amplify the value of music. Driven by machine learning and copyright expertise, our system pumps neutral data and authoritative knowledge to everyone along the chain. For those who make or use music, we allow them to plug in to our O.S. to ease operations, increase earnings, and get in sync with everyone else.

What You'll Be Doing

Your main responsibility will be to maintain and continuously improve our systems infrastructure, automating key processes such as setup, deployment and monitoring. You are expected to proactively take care of our platforms like your own little tech babies, improving your skills in the process and staying up to date with the latest technologies.

Requirements

You must have
• Experience setting up and maintaining cloud infrastructure in AWS
• Experience using Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Git and... Docker for continuous integration
• Proficiency in networks and security (VPN, routing, firewalls)
• Your natural OS is Linux
• You use your knowledge of Shell and Python automation tools to avoid repeating yourself
• You are organized in your work, and love monitoring and logging your platforms
• You have English working proficiency
• You are an excellent team player

It would be great if you also have:
• Our tech stack is mainly Python, AWS, MongoDB, Elastic
• Git proficiency
• Jenkins experience

Benefits

You Can Enjoy
• Flexible working hours and location
• Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest
• We'll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
• Flat hierarchy
• You can make the role your own and run your own development
• Online language classes to improve your Spanish, Catalan or English
• Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
• Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/

Who The FAQ Are BMAT

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We're now over 200 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, Nairobi, Oslo, Tel-Aviv, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We're a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We're open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We've got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music, the excitement for innovative technology and Barcelona as a backdrop has proven to make a good combination.

Join us from wherever you are on our mission to help make music live forever.

We say there's a BMAT touch. We believe it has to do with being passionate, obsessive, nice, generous, honest, self-motivated, entrepreneurial, intrepid, crazy, extraordinary, creative, agile, human, friendly, smart, witty, talented, naive, optimistic, surprising, sensual, and nerdy, but not very hipster (unfortunately). Our way of being is always sprinkled with transparency, perseverance, flexibility, open-mindedness and trustworthiness.

Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work

jobs_results.title: Devops
jobs_results.description: • Estamos reclutando un/a DevOps para reforzar nuestro equipo en Madrid con la posibilidad de trabajar en un régimen híbrido.Lo que buscamos:Profundo conocimiento de las prácticas y principios de DevOps, incluyendo la integración continua (CI) y la entrega continua (CD), infraestructura como código (IaC), automatización de pruebas, y monitoreo; Aunque el enfoque es GCP, el arquitecto debe tener experiencia en múltiples plataformas de nube (como AWS, Azure, etc.) para asegurar un enfoque agnóstico en la arquitectura y las herramientas utilizadas; Dominio en herramientas de integración y despliegue continuo, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, y Cloud Build, con la habilidad de adaptar estos procesos en distintos entornos de nube; Experiencia con herramientas como Terraform, CloudFormation (para AWS), y Deployment Manager (para GCP), permitiendo la gestión agnóstica de infraestructuras; Conocimientos sólidos en Docker y Kubernetes, incluido Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), para... gestionar contenedores de manera eficiente en diferentes plataformas de nube; Habilidad para implementar soluciones de monitorización y logging que pueden ser utilizadas a través de plataformas, como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), y las herramientas nativas de GCP como Cloud Monitoring y Cloud Logging; Capacidad para guiar y mentorizar a equipos de desarrollo y operaciones en la adopción de prácticas DevOps, incluyendo la promoción de la cultura de colaboración entre equipos; Experiencia en la gestión de proyectos utilizando metodologías ágiles, asegurando que las implementaciones de DevOps se alineen con los objetivos de negocio y cronogramas del cliente; Habilidades excepcionales de comunicación para interactuar con stakeholders del cliente, equipos de desarrollo, y operaciones, traduciendo requisitos complejos en soluciones técnicas viables; Comprensión de cómointegrar prácticas de seguridad en el ciclo de vida de desarrollo y despliegue de aplicaciones (SDLC), asegurando que las soluciones sean seguras por diseño; Fluidez en inglés (obligatorio), francés (valorado).Lo que tenemos para ofrecer:Flexibilidad en el régimen de trabajo (híbrido); Oportunidad de crecimiento profesional en una empresa en crecimiento; Ambiente de trabajocolaborativo y de apoyo; Paquete competitivode beneficios.Si te identificas con este perfil, envíanos tu CV actualizado a ****** deseas obtener más información sobre nosotros:Movilges IT Consulting cuenta con más de 30 años de experiencia en el mercado español, especializada en Logística, Movilidad e IT. Ofrecemos servicios de consultoría, desarrollo de aplicaciones y mantenimiento de sistemas

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Hey, we’re Sparta Commodities!

We are a Swiss, VC-backed scaleup with a global reach. Our mission is to digitize the commodity trading market and become the leading platform for traders in all commodities verticals. We’ve already gained significant market traction and are financially backed by Venture Investors.

Sparta currently has a fantastic opportunity for a driven and passionate DevOps Engineer to join our growing Engineering team, based in Spain. You will be an integral part of the infrastructure team helping to implement and maintain the AWS infrastructure, designing future changes for the architecture, monitoring services, managing infrastructure costs, and planning for future expenditures.

We are a fully remote company with a modern tech stack, and we strive for fast deployments to support the rapid growth we are experiencing, this hire is key to our continued success.

Requirements
• Minimum of 5 years of experience as an AWS Architect.
• Proficient in CDK.
• Previous... exposure to Amazon MSK (Kafka), Lambda, RDS, VPC, networking, Fargate, and Redshift.
• Familiarity with Serverless technology.
• Expertise in CI/CD pipelines and deployment protocols.
• Proficiency in system monitoring and audit processes.
• Demonstrated ability in designing high-availability architectures.
• Advanced proficiency in English.

Bonus Points
• Previous involvement in trading or fintech sectors.
• Experience contributing to a startup or scaleup growth stage.
• Familiarity with SOC2 or ISO27001 standards.
• Proficiency in using Datadog.
• Knowledge of Terraform would be advantageous.
• Experience in network infrastructure and security protocols.

What’s the culture like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is not just a set of values written on a wall—it's a way of life. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives.

We're building an environment where our employees thrive and excel in their work. Our aim is for every member of our team to take pride in their contributions. You'll collaborate with like-minded individuals who are passionate about our mission and deeply committed to crafting outstanding products and achieving success for our customers.

We operate remotely, understanding that a thriving, profitable company isn't just about being in the same location. We build our relationships through effective remote work methods and carefully planned in-person meet-ups.

What we offer
• Remote working, with occasional travel to a central hub for collaborative meetings and coordination.
• Attractive company stock option plan.
• Yearly companywide meet-ups in sunny locations.
• Training and education budget.
• Private Medical Insurance.
• Access to the optimal gear suited for your position.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. As an international business, we are determined that suitably qualified persons will never receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer .NET
jobs_results.description:
En AXPE Consulting estamos transformando el mundo de la Tecnología. Por ello, te invitamos a vivir una experiencia única desarrollando tu carrera en una Compañía multinacional que mira hacia el futuro. Nuestros valores definen nuestra identidad, son la palanca que nos ayuda a hacer realidad nuestro propósito y guían todas nuestras acciones y decisiones: apostamos por el TALENTO.

Desde el departamento de IT, buscamos un perfil de DevOps Engineer para participar en un proyecto tecnológico interesante y retador de uno de nuestros principales clientes 👩🚀🚀

¿Qué buscamos de ti?
• Experiencia de más de 3 años en programación con .NET 6/7.
• Experiencia en el uso de repositorios GIT de código, deseable Azure DevOps.
• Experiencia sólida en desarrollo en la nube de Azure.
• Experiencia en scripting y arquitectura de Kubernetes y Dockers.
• Experiencia en implementación de API.
• Experiencia en la aplicación de los conceptos de CI/CD.
• Experiencia en Bases de datos SQL y NoSQL (SQL... Server, Redis, InfluxDB, MongoDB).
• Experiencia en principios y patrones de diseño como SOLID, KISS, DRY, Creational, Structural, Behavioral...
• Experiencia con TDD y creación de los diferentes tipos de pruebas, como de unidad, integración, carga, estrés, etc.

¿Cuál será tu reto?
• Funciones de ingeniería y creación de productos digitales en entornos ágiles.
• Programar en .NET, con microservicios distribuidos, escalables y resilientes, conservando un enfoque práctico.
• Uso de métodos DevOps y entrega continua (CI/CD).
• Mantenimiento del ciclo de vida de API públicas e internas a gran escala, incluido su diseño, implementación y amortización.
• Estrategias de pruebas de sistemas distribuidos.
• Implementación de arquitecturas de nube a gran escala utilizando plataformas de contenedores modernas basadas en la nube (PaaS/SaaS).

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

📈 Oportunidad de desarrollar tu carrera en contexto global.

👨💻 Contrato indefinido.

⚕ Seguro médico a precio reducido (para ti y familiares directos).

📚 Formaciones y certificaciones a nuestro cargo, que te permitan crecer profesionalmente junto a nosotros.

⏰ Horario estándar con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.

📍 Modalidad 100% remota.

💸 Salario competitivo.

🚀 Formar parte de una compañía donde se fomentan las comunidades tecnológicas, el intercambio de conocimiento y la excelencia técnica.

En AXPE estamos orgullosos de ser una empresa experta en tecnología que apuesta fuerte por el talento. La responsabilidad corporativa es inherente a nuestro modelo de negocio, impulsamos la educación tecnológica tanto a nivel formativo como laboral.

📢 📢 Formar parte de AXPE es liderar la transformación del sector tecnológico

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Eres SRE/DevOps Engineer? Trabaja en una empresa global con sede en España, Hungría y Suiza, utilizar tecnología de vanguardia y súmate a un equipo lleno de talento ¡Esta es tu oportunidad!

Nuestro Cliente:

Empresa tecnológica que desde el 2014 diseña y desarrolla soluciones digitales para mejorar y fortalecer la relación entre las personas y los servicios, públicos y privados.

Dirigidos a establecimientos medianos y grandes, complejos y dinámicos, que buscan digitalizar sus servicios, ofreciendo una respuesta concreta a los problemas de la gestión de los flujos de clientes.

Descripción del puesto:

Buscamos un ingeniero experimentado en confiabilidad del sitio y DevOps que tenga pasión por crear soluciones de vanguardia. Esta función implica gestionar y desarrollar soluciones complejas en la nube para clientes internacionales en colaboración con los equipos de desarrollo, garantizando un entorno de trabajo estable y contribuyendo a mejorar nuestra plataforma de desarrollo... interna.

Esperamos que tengas:
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en gestión de infraestructuras basadas en la nube.
• Comprensión de conceptos de IaC, DevOps y GitOps
• CI/CD, contenedores Docker, Kubernetes
• Experiencia de proveedor de nube (GCP/AWS/Azure)
• Abierto para aprender lenguajes de programación (especialmente Elixir)
• Experiencia en gestión de canalizaciones (Gitlab CI/CD)
• Experiencia en gestión de Kubernetes.
• Buena intuición para resolver problemas.
• Es bueno tener: experiencia con Config Connector, Terraform, administración de GKE, Elixir

Valorable:

jobs_results.title: AWS DevOps Engineer - Data Science
jobs_results.description:
Ryanair Labs is the technology brand of Ryanair. Labs is a state of-the-art digital & IT innovation hub creating Europe's Leading Travel Experience for our customers. The Ryanair platform has over 1 billion visits per year. By joining Ryanair, you will develop cutting edge tech solutions inside Ryanair, transforming aviation for Pilots, Cabin Crew & Ground Ops, as well as driving the tech experience for our customers on Europe's largest travel website!

Ryanair Labs has more than 550 employees across our offices in Dublin, Madrid, Poland, and Portugal. Our plan is to continue to grow our IT Labs Team so we are always on the lookout for the best talent. Apply today for more information.

The Role

The Data Team is currently seeking a highly motivated individual to join our Cloud Engineering team as an AWS DevOps Engineer for a permanent position based in our Madrid HQ. This is a hands-on role where you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and managing CICD pipelines... specifically tailored for data science projects.

Your tasks will include
• Developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for data science projects using AWS services (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodeDeploy) and relevant data processing tools.
• Collaborate with data scientists to understand their requirements for data processing, model training, and deployment, and provide solutions
• Automate data workflows and integrate data science and machine learning code into production systems
• Managing and optimizing our cloud infrastructure on AWS, closely monitoring resource usage, and implementing cost-saving measures to ensure efficient utilization of resources and optimal cost-effectiveness
• Analysing and optimizing various infrastructure components to enhance scalability, improve system response times, and deliver an exceptional user experience
• Facilitate the creation of development, staging, and production environments for data science projects using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
• Proactively staying up to date with the latest cloud trends, technologies, and assessing new service offerings to identify potential opportunities to improve our data science lifecycle

Requirements
• At least 3-5 years of experience in a DevOps role
• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices and tools, such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies.
• Strong understanding and practical experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) concepts and tools
• Understanding of containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) is a plus
• Experience working with source code management tools such as AWS Code Commit or GitHub
• Familiarity with AWS security services and best practices for securing infrastructure and applications
• Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python) and familiar with data science workflows.
• A team player with strong communication skills
• Desire to learn and improve your skills

Benefits

What is like working in Ryanair as Developer
• We promote innovation, all our teams are Agile and several PoCs of new technologies or innovative ideas are launched every week
• A competitive but flexible technical career plan
• We believe in an hybrid working model, you can work up to three days per week remote, but you are also going to enjoy the excellent work environment at our modern offices in the heart of Madrid
• We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country
• Travel discounts (of course

jobs_results.title: Técnico (a) Devops
jobs_results.description:
¿Por qué TE NECESITAMOS? … porque necesitamos incorporar en nuestros equipos internos un (a) técnico (a) Devops

Te incorporarás a nuestros equipos internos y te desempeñarás como DevOps trabajando en nuestras infraestructuras.

Podrás trabajar en remoto.

¿Qué requisitos he de cumplir?
• Tienes que ser una persona con formación técnica ciclo, universitaria o grado superior.
• Experiencia de al menos 2 años como técnico (a) Devops.
• Persona inquieta, que le guste la tecnología, ordenada y que le gusten los retos.
• Ser una persona comprometida, confiable y responsable. Orientada al trabajo en equipo, al aprendizaje, proactiva, resolutiva y acostumbrada a trabajar con autonomía.

¿Qué perfil tecnológico he de aportar?
• Experiencia en Scripting (preferiblemente con comandos en Linux).
• Experiencia y/o conocimientos de Azure u otros sistemas Cloud para provisionamiento de los recursos.
• Experiencia y/o conocimientos de Docker o Kubernetes (Preferiblemente AKS)
• Experiencia y/o... conocimiento de tecnologías de creación de infraestructura bajo código o scripting (Terraform, Ansible o similar).

¿Qué requisitos valoráis a mayores?
• Conocimiento de Redes
• Conocimiento de herramientas de monitorización, Grafana, Prometheus.
• Conocimiento de RabbitMQ
• Conocimiento de Elasticsearch
• Conocimiento de Azure pipelines

¿Cuáles serán mis funciones?
• Mantener la infraestructura de producción de los diferentes proyectos basados en una plataforma de desarrollo propia.
• Añadir nuevos componentes, balancear los existentes y provisionar nuevos clústeres.
• Dar soporte a los desarrolladores.
• Proponer mejoras
• Búsqueda de la innovación y de la optimización de elementos de la infraestructura (ayudando a reducir costes)
• Búsqueda de la resiliencia en la infraestructura (que la infraestructura se escale y se repare sola estudiando los puntos críticos).

¿Qué me ofrecéis?
• Incorporación a una empresa consolidada y a un proyecto en crecimiento y desarrollo.
• contrato indefinido, teletrabajo y buen ambiente laboral, en el que prima la colaboración y el espíritu de equipo y pertenencia.
• Formación continua y trabajar con entornos tecnológicos innovadores.

¿Te identificas?

¡Queremos conocerte! Te garantizamos absoluta confidencialidad en todo el proceso absoluta confidencialidad en todo el proceso

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job description:

We are hiring.

We are currently looking for a DevOps Engineer to develope and execute a Development Operations (DevSecOps) strategy to ensure quality software and infrastructure deployments and overall application health, security and performance.

You will work within the team that develops state of the art products and solutions based on Idemia technologies, with plenty of opportunities to advance your technical skills and get exposure to new technologies. You will help to deploy software components and support integration and deployment with your expertise.

Tasks:
• Define the system integration strategy and configuring, installing and validating IDEMIAs solutions that best addresses customers’ requirements and optimize IDEMIAs business value
• Build the integration environment and installs the solution or upgrades it
• Create technical documentation such as installation/configuration/maintenance procedures
• Clarify and refine requirements with Product... Owner/Business Analyst

As part of IDEMIA's Malaga team, you will:
• Define and implement architectures CI/CD (Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment) process tailored for the team’s environment
• Develop infrastructure to incorporate latest technology best practices, and improve operational performance
• Improve development, deployment and testing to make it as much automated as possible
• Support teams by sharing knowledge and best practices (including clear documents for complex integration procedures)
• Operate and debug complex integration processes and environments in autonomy
• Coache and guide less experienced DevOps/DevSecOps Engineers
• Give training and share best practices

Profile description:

Who are we looking for?

To succeed in this position, you will need the following skills:

Required:
• Master’s or equivalent degree (4+ years) in Computer Science or related discipline
• Minimum 2-3 years in software deployment in commercial software products
• OS: Linux management and administration
• Docker and Docker compose
• Intermediate verbal and written skills in English would be a plus

Desired:
• Kubernetes, Docker Swarm
• Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud
• Databases: MySQL
• Tools: JIRA, git, maven, Jenkins, Confluence
• Real passion for digital
• You’re a self-motivated individual with attention to details and strong problem-solving skills
• Good interpersonal skills

Let us know if you have an experience with:
• QA skills (Test Scenarios, Test automatization)
• Java, Spring, React
• OVA, QCOW2, Openshift
• VMWare

In addition to his/her technical abilities, the ideal candidate needs to match our community's values: at IDEMIA we are curious, trusted, caring, daring and together.

We offer:

Why should you choose IDEMIA?

By choosing to work at IDEMIA, you will join a unique tech company, offering a wide range of growth opportunities. You will contribute to a safer world, collaborating with an international and global community. We value the diversity of our teams and welcome people from all walks of life, regardless of how they look, where they come from, who they love, or what they think.

We deliver cutting edge, future proof innovation that reach the highest technological standards and we’re transforming, fast, to stay a leader in a world that’s changing fast, too.

At IDEMIA, people can develop their expertise and feel a sense of ownership and empowerment, in a global environment, as part of a company with the ambition and the ability to change the world.

In IDEMIA, Malaga, you may expect:
• Joining senior team and work with technical gurus
• Shining with your IT skills
• Using and developing exciting new technologies
• On arrival, you will benefit from an onboarding program that will allow you to quickly increase your skills
• Team building activities
• Hybrid work mode (homeoffice 3 days per week)
• Flexible working hours
• Private Medical Insurance
• Life insurance

IDEMIA. Expect the unexpected. Join the journey of a unique tech company.

Visit our website to know more about us:

www.idemia.com

Emilia Banasiak

emilia.banasiak@idemia.com

https://www.linkedin.com/in/emilia-paula-banasiak-4157496

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Senior DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Would you like to be part of an ambitious international project? We are waiting for you!

Viewnext is a technology consulting and digital transformation services company belonging to the IBM Group.

We currently have a team of more than 4,600 professionals and a network of offices and innovation centers.

FUNCTIONS:

Design, Implement and oversee the DevOps strategy for the project. This includes but is not limited to the

- CI/CD workflow (Version Control, and automated deployments)

- Sandbox Management

- Documenting releases

- Overseeing the Developer Workflow and ensuring Code Reviews take place.

- Work closely with QA, Tech Leads, Senior Devs and Architects to ensure the smooth delivery of build artefacts into Salesforce environments.

- Implement scripts utilising the Salesforce Metadata API and SFDX

- Refine technical user stories as required, articulate clearly the technical solution required to meet a specific requirement.

- Support the Tech Lead with ensuring best... practises are adhered to, providing mentorship and code review feedback as required.

- Work with Tech Leads to author Technical Design Documents, ensuring adherence to design patterns.

- Ownership of the development workflow for the development team and ability to guide and effectively communicate the workflow to Development teams

REQUIREMENTS

- Knowledge in Salesforce Development

- Strong experience CI/CD technologies, Git (version control), Salesforce Metadata API, SFDX

- Expertise in large-scale integration using SOAP, REST, Streaming (including Lightning Events), and Metadata APIs, facilitating the seamless connection of Salesforce with other systems.

- Excellent technical documentation skills

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
